thiet-ke-cang.title: Port Equipment Design & Installation
thiet-ke-cang.desc: Providing design, construction, and renovation services for port equipment systems such as cranes and container transportation systems.
thiet-ke-cang.fullContent: We understand that in the port industry, every moment of downtime causes major economic damage. Therefore, Maintech's solutions always focus on two factors: Maximum performance and Absolute reliability. With a team of engineers deeply trained in STS and RTG crane systems, we confidently undertake the most complex projects from technical design to site installation.
features: Design and installation of STS and RTG crane systems
Unscheduled and periodic maintenance to optimize operation
Upgrade control systems for older generation equipment
Test and load testing according to international maritime safety standards

thiet-ke-f-b.title: F&B Equipment Design & Installation
thiet-ke-f-b.desc: Microbiological production lines, storage tanks, and automatic packaging solutions for the food and beverage industry.
thiet-ke-f-b.fullContent: Food safety is the top priority in the F&B industry. Maintech provides microbiological stainless steel piping systems, ASME standard tanks, and automation solutions that minimize human intervention in the production process. We consult and implement modern CIP (Clean-In-Place) systems that save water and chemicals while ensuring maximum sterility for the system.
features: High standard stainless steel tanks and piping systems
Installation of automatic processing and packaging equipment
Optimization of factory space and operational processes
Digitization of reporting processes and quality management

thiet-ke-nang-ha.title: Lifting Equipment Design & Installation
thiet-ke-nang-ha.desc: Design, manufacture, and installation of industrial lifting systems for workshops, warehouses, and construction sites.
thiet-ke-nang-ha.fullContent: Maintech provides tailor-made overhead cranes, gantry cranes, and freight elevators suitable for the structure and purpose of each workshop. All equipment is integrated with multi-layer safety systems, including load sensors, travel limits, and the most modern emergency braking systems.
features: Design of cranes, freight elevators, and conveyors
Installation according to strict technical standards
Provide genuine parts and fast support
Periodic safety inspection and operation licensing

bao-tri-cang.title: Port Equipment Maintenance & Repair
bao-tri-cang.desc: Professional maintenance for port crane systems, ensuring 24/7 continuous operation.
bao-tri-cang.fullContent: Our maintenance service includes periodic inspection of mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic systems of STS and RTG cranes. We commit to fast response times to minimize downtime at the port.
features: Replacement of hoisting cables and brake system inspection

bao-tri-f-b.title: F&B Equipment Maintenance & Repair
bao-tri-f-b.desc: Maintenance service for food production systems, meeting strict hygiene standards.
bao-tri-f-b.fullContent: Ensure the production line is always in top condition with periodic maintenance. We provide flexible solution packages suitable for the production schedule of the factory.
features: Maintenance of tanks and stainless steel piping

bao-tri-nang-ha.title: Lifting Equipment Maintenance & Repair
bao-tri-nang-ha.desc: Comprehensive maintenance solutions for industrial lifting systems.
bao-tri-nang-ha.fullContent: Lifting systems need to be inspected regularly to ensure occupational safety. Maintech provides a full service from inspection to repair and replacement of components.
features: Periodic safety inspection and load testing
Repair of bridge beams and brake systems
Fast supply of replacement parts and supplies

cung-cap-xay-dung.fullContent: We provide construction machinery and equipment from the world's leading brands, ensuring performance and durability in harsh environments.
features: Consulting on equipment solutions for construction

intro.title: INTRODUCTION
intro.content1: Maintechvn specializes in designing, installing, and maintaining port equipment, industrial lifting systems, and F&B systems in Vietnam and Southeast Asia.
intro.content2: Established in 2020, Maintech Vietnam operates in the field of design, installation, and maintenance of industrial equipment, mechanical construction, and factory technical systems. We have participated in many projects in Ho Chi Minh City, Cambodia, Malaysia, and Southeast Asia.
intro.content3: With experience working in multi-national environments and collaborating with technical partners in Germany, we provide total solutions from survey, technical advice to post-handover maintenance.
